_comment: Machine-readable registry of EXTERNAL companion tools for the Sapote-Mamey analysis workflow. DESIGN DECISION: these tools are DETECTED, not BUNDLED. The Mamey offline core (deterministic extraction, judgment deferred) installs and runs with no network and no companion tool present. This file lets a new user (and `mamey doctor --companions`) discover which optional downstream tools are installed, what each one consumes/produces relative to a sealed Mamey package, and exactly how to obtain it on their platform. It NEVER makes any tool a requirement. Edit THIS file; mamey/companion_tools.py loads it and tests/test_companion_tools_registry.py guards it. Versions/commands were confirmed on macOS-arm64 (miniconda3, Python 3.13) on 2026-07-20; see docs/companion_tools.md for the human-readable guide. Registry version_verified values are historical install-note metadata, not current runtime or study-execution receipts. Numeric expected_version comparisons and verify_flag review states are reported separately; web/manual entries are not executed. Native tool-specific compatibility/resource/model gates remain authoritative.

install_method_fields.binary: prebuilt platform binary or source build (not pip/conda)

tools.name: antiSMASH
tools.purpose: Genome-mining annotation engine that detects biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) regions; its output ZIP is the primary input to the entire Sapote-Mamey pipeline.
tools.consumes: Genome assembly (nucleotide FASTA / GenBank).
tools.produces: antiSMASH output ZIP containing per-region GBKs (*.regionNNN.gbk), region JSON, and KnownClusterBlast/RiQ/Pfam/TIGRFAM evidence — the exact ZIP Mamey `run --input-zip` parses.

install.command: conda install -n antismash -c bioconda antismash && download-antismash-databases
install.notes: Heavyweight; a Docker image (antismash/standalone) is the common route. Not installable inside the offline Mamey core.

install.command: docker run --rm antismash/standalone-lite <in> <out>  # or use the antiSMASH web server
install.reference_db: bundled in Docker image / downloaded on first run
install.notes: No native osx-arm64 conda build tracked; use Docker or the public web server (https://antismash.secondarymetabolites.org).

tools.name: GECCO
tools.purpose: Optional independent probabilistic BGC second opinion; presence or low probability does not prove or disprove a cluster.
tools.consumes: Genome assembly (nucleotide FASTA or GenBank).
tools.produces: Predicted cluster GBKs + a features/clusters TSV; use as a cross-check against Mamey's antiSMASH-derived inventory (2_inventory.csv).

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: gecco-crosscheck --package <package> --zip <source.zip>; outputs are external and source-hash-bound

install.command: conda create -n gecco -c conda-forge -c bioconda gecco=0.11.0
install.reference_db: ~40 MB CRF model bundled in the wheel (no external DB)
install.notes: Pulls arm64 wheels for pyhmmer/pyrodigal/scikit-learn/polars — no compiler needed.

tools.name: BiG-SCAPE
tools.purpose: Clusters BGC regions into run-specific gene-cluster families (GCFs) and clans for cohort similarity analysis.
tools.consumes: Strain-prefixed antiSMASH region GBKs (one file per region).
tools.produces: GCF/clan assignments, portable locator-keyed tables, network/tree outputs, and an interactive HTML browser; no identity/activity/novelty claim.

mamey_io.mamey_input: additive GCF sidecar only; canonical reconciliation requires separate authorization
mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: antiSMASH region GBKs referenced by a sealed package and staged content-addressably

install.command: conda create -n sapote-bigscape -c conda-forge -c bioconda bigscape
install.reference_db: Pfam-A HMM database (~1.5 GB, press once with hmmpress); MIBiG reference set optional
install.notes: Networked installation requires approval. Invoke the version-probed `bigscape` console executable directly with the `cluster` subcommand. Hash Pfam assets; MIBiG download/reference use is a separate approved action. Active contract: docs/LLM_COMPANION_TOOL_PROTOCOL.md.

tools.name: cblaster
tools.purpose: Finds co-located homologue clusters across genomes (remote NCBI BLAST or local DIAMOND); a targeted "who else carries this BGC?" query without a full BiG-SCAPE run.
tools.consumes: A query set of BGC protein FASTAs (e.g. a flagship BGC's CDS).
tools.produces: A cluster hit table + a session that pipes directly into clinker / plot_clusters for synteny figures.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: per-BGC protein FASTAs derivable from the region GBKs in the sealed package (source_gbk column of *_2b_bgc_crosswalk.csv)

install.reference_db: none for remote NCBI mode; optional local DIAMOND DB you build yourself
install.notes: Remote mode needs network; local mode needs a DIAMOND DB. Use the cblaster console script (no `python -m cblaster`).

tools.name: clinker
tools.purpose: Generates gene-cluster synteny/alignment figures across a set of related BGC loci (interactive HTML + SVG).
tools.consumes: A directory of region GBKs (from one strain or across a GCF).
tools.produces: An interactive HTML synteny plot + static SVG for manuscripts / Mode-B cards.

mamey_io.mamey_input: clinker figures are attached to Mode-B / cohort deliverables (non-blocking, post-seal)
mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: region GBKs referenced by the source_gbk column of *_2b_bgc_crosswalk.csv, or staged via tools/bigscape_prep.py

install.notes: Pure-Python; console script `clinker`.

tools.name: pyGenomeViz
tools.purpose: Matplotlib genome/feature-track visualizer for scriptable, reproducible BGC locus figures (SVG/PDF export).
tools.consumes: GenBank or GFF (a region GBK, or a whole-genome record).
tools.produces: Publication BGC/genome track figures (alternative to hand-tweaking clinker SVGs).

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: region GBKs from the sealed package (source_gbk column of *_2b_bgc_crosswalk.csv)

install.notes: Pure-Python; imports as `pygenomeviz` (no console-script version flag — detect by import).

tools.name: pyCirclize
tools.purpose: Circular (Circos-style) genome and comparative plots — whole-genome BGC location maps and cohort comparison rings.
tools.consumes: GenBank / tabular genome coordinates.
tools.produces: Circular genome figures for cohort and whole-genome BGC maps.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: BGC coordinates from *_2b_bgc_crosswalk.csv / 2_inventory.csv and the genome record

install.notes: Pure-Python; imports as `pycirclize` (detect by import).

tools.name: Prodigal
tools.purpose: Prokaryotic gene prediction; produces the protein/CDS calls that feed marker extraction for MLSA / phylogenomics.
tools.consumes: Genome assembly (nucleotide FASTA).
tools.produces: Protein FASTA (.faa) + nucleotide CDS (.ffn) used to recover phylogenetic marker loci.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: whole-genome FASTA reconstructed from the antiSMASH JSON inside the sealed package

install.notes: Small C binary; also bundled by GToTree. Pure-Python binding available as pyrodigal (already in the Sapote add-ons).

tools.name: MUSCLE
tools.purpose: Multiple sequence alignment of marker loci prior to tree inference.
tools.consumes: Unaligned marker protein/nucleotide FASTA (e.g. per-locus MLSA sets).
tools.produces: A multiple sequence alignment (FASTA/AFA) for concatenation and tree building.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: marker loci extracted downstream of the sealed package (taxonomy layer)

install.notes: Single binary; bioconda builds osx-arm64.

tools.name: IQ-TREE
tools.purpose: Maximum-likelihood phylogenetic tree inference with model selection and ultrafast bootstrap.
tools.consumes: A concatenated multiple sequence alignment (+ optional partition file).
tools.produces: A species / MLSA tree (.treefile) for taxonomy placement and cohort context.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: alignment built from marker loci recovered downstream of the sealed package

install.notes: Binary invoked as `iqtree3` (or `iqtree`) in the phylo env; bioconda builds osx-arm64.

tools.name: fastANI
tools.purpose: Fast whole-genome Average Nucleotide Identity for species delineation and cohort de-replication.
tools.consumes: Two or more genome assemblies (nucleotide FASTA).
tools.produces: Pairwise ANI values (%) + aligned fraction — the numeric basis for the ~95% species boundary.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: whole-genome FASTAs reconstructed from the antiSMASH JSON across a cohort of sealed packages

install.notes: C++/HDF5 binary; bioconda builds osx-arm64. skani (see below) is the newer, fragmentation-robust alternative.

tools.name: GToTree
tools.purpose: Turn-key genome phylogenomics: single-copy HMM marker sets to a concatenated species tree.
tools.consumes: A bounded, de-replicated set of local whole-genome assemblies; reference downloads are staged separately.
tools.produces: A marker alignment and sampled-panel phylogenomic placement; not formal taxonomy or species identity.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: whole-genome assemblies recovered source-preservingly from antiSMASH ZIPs

install.command: conda create -n sapote-phylo -c conda-forge -c bioconda gtotree iqtree fastani ncbi-datasets-cli
install.reference_db: bundled single-copy HMM sets (small); pulls HMMER/Prodigal/Muscle/etc.
install.notes: Released GToTree 1.8.19 is the workflow priority. The unreleased v2 rewrite is experimental source integration, not a released production workflow; further native v2 work is deferred. Installation/upgrade requires authorization and the Bioconda channel can change. Shared interface policy admits 1.8.19 and 2.0.x, refusing 1.8.16. For 1.8.19 the serial alignment flags are -j 1 -n 1 -M 1 -N; 2.0.x omits -n and uses detailed help -s. Native v2 also requires its separately admitted source/runtime profile, fresh software-probe receipt, recorded approval and explicit CPU budget; reviewed HMM search requests two workers per genome job even with -j 1 -M 1. -B remains optional and requires a multiplicity/paralogy audit. Active contract: docs/LLM_COMPANION_TOOL_PROTOCOL.md.

detection.historical_version_note: Previous registry recorded 1.8.16; current shared interface policy refuses it. This is not evidence of a current installation or study execution. Admission of a 2.0.x interface is experimental source compatibility, not release readiness or a recommendation to use it for study analyses.

tools.battle_tested: Historical cohort-use note: cross-genus core-genome placement (2026-07; confirmatory backbone over 6-locus MLSA). This is not current installation or native-run validation; bind original version and run receipts before using it as Methods evidence.

tools.name: NCBI datasets
tools.purpose: Command-line client to fetch reference genomes/assemblies from NCBI for taxonomy comparison sets.
tools.consumes: NCBI accessions / taxon names.
tools.produces: Downloaded reference genome FASTAs used as the comparator panel for ANI and phylogenomics.

install.notes: Network required at fetch time; the binary itself installs offline from conda-forge.

tools.name: skani
tools.purpose: Fast, fragmentation-robust ANI + aligned fraction (a fastANI successor) for de-replicating a large strain cohort.
tools.consumes: Genome assemblies / contigs (nucleotide FASTA).
tools.produces: Pairwise ANI + aligned fraction robust to draft-assembly fragmentation.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: whole-genome FASTAs reconstructed across a cohort of sealed packages

install.notes: ON REQUEST. Rust binary (not pip); bioconda now builds osx-arm64.

tools.name: GTDB-Tk
tools.purpose: Standardized genome taxonomy classification against the GTDB reference.
tools.consumes: Genome assemblies (nucleotide FASTA).
tools.produces: GTDB taxonomy assignments for placing novel Streptomyces / Pseudonocardia.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: whole-genome FASTAs reconstructed from sealed packages

install.command: conda install -c bioconda gtdbtk  # then download the GTDB reference DB
install.reference_db: GTDB reference database ~100 GB (HEAVY — violates the no-big-DB norm; decide before pulling)
install.notes: ON REQUEST / heavy-DB. The tool installs from bioconda but the ~100 GB reference DB is a separate deliberate download.

tools.name: NPLinker
tools.purpose: Integrates genome-side BGC/GCF and operator-supplied MS observations; associations require separate review.
tools.consumes: Prepared genomic and metabolomic data with strain-to-data mappings; staged region GBKs or spectra alone are not a complete linked NPLinker dataset.
tools.produces: Separate external analysis; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: export-metabolomics source staging and broad class hypotheses where applicable

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Environment-specific; no installation or network access performed by the doctor.

tools.name: PRISM
tools.purpose: Optional class-level genome-side reference interpretation; no product prediction is adopted by this bridge.
tools.consumes: Genome-side sequence data for the external PRISM workflow; not mass-spectrometry inputs. Current web-service availability and version readiness are unverified.
tools.produces: Separate external analysis; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: export-metabolomics source staging and broad class hypotheses where applicable

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Environment-specific; no installation or network access performed by the doctor.

detection.command: python -c "import sys; sys.exit('WEB_SERVICE_OR_MANUAL_INSTALL; not probed offline')"

tools.name: GNPS/MASST
tools.purpose: Operator-controlled MS/MS similarity and networking; no submission is made by Mamey.
tools.consumes: Operator-supplied MS/MS spectra and associated metadata for GNPS/MASST; genome-region GBKs are not MASST query spectra.
tools.produces: Separate external analysis; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: export-metabolomics source staging and broad class hypotheses where applicable

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Environment-specific; no installation or network access performed by the doctor.

detection.command: python -c "import sys; sys.exit('WEB_SERVICE; not probed offline')"

tools.name: SIRIUS/CANOPUS
tools.purpose: Annotates classes from operator-supplied MS/MS; mapped genome hypotheses are not CANOPUS predictions.
tools.consumes: Operator-supplied MS/MS spectra, with MS data where available, for SIRIUS/CANOPUS; not genome-region GBKs.
tools.produces: Separate external analysis; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: export-metabolomics source staging and broad class hypotheses where applicable

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Environment-specific; no installation or network access performed by the doctor.

tools.name: DeepBGC
tools.purpose: Optional independent genome-side BGC detector; not run by this export.
tools.consumes: Genome-side sequence records accepted by the external DeepBGC tool; not mass-spectrometry inputs.
tools.produces: Separate external analysis; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: export-metabolomics source staging and broad class hypotheses where applicable

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Environment-specific; no installation or network access performed by the doctor.

tools.name: BiG-SLiCE
tools.purpose: Optional genome-side large-scale BGC clustering; GCF assignments remain method-specific.
tools.consumes: Source-bound genome-side antiSMASH region GBKs; query additionally requires an explicitly writable model, exact run, compatible HMM library and reviewed runtime/model manifests.
tools.produces: Additive PRIVATE selected-model/run membership exports with complete locus identity and attempt receipts; no package scoring or scientific promotion.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: Hash-bound native manifest BGC identities and matching original source-region GBKs; no metabolomics inputs.

install.notes: Detected, not bundled. Unknown runtime/model compatibility is held. No installation, download or model computation is performed by doctor; see docs/BIGSLICE_WORKFLOW.md.

tools.name: CORASON (optional original pinned profile)
tools.purpose: Optional query-centered conserved-gene-core locus comparison. Multilocus, query-only and BLAST-order routes are distinct; no species/product/activity/assembly-link claim.
tools.consumes: Explicit independently public source/package roster, exact full-locus/query CDS selection, externally provisioned source/runtime/resource review manifest; no raw private AS inputs in initial profile.
tools.produces: PRIVATE scoped portable evidence with exact locus/neighborhood/leaf crosswalk, prefilter denominators, core/alignments/tree/order/SVG bindings and truthful actual route; raw SVG is not visual admission.

mamey_io.consumes_mamey_output: Validated package identity and matching original antiSMASH region members, downstream and additive only.

install.notes: Not installed, downloaded, vendored or executed by this registry. Preferred source aa70dddebafb210445794fd24b1c6b2e4177c58c; AGPL-3.0; internal POD0.01 is not a release. See docs/CORASON_WORKFLOW.md.

detection.command: python -c "reason='CORASON NOT_PROBED: external source/runtime/resource admission required'; raise SystemExit(2)"
